Hi Samir — thanks for the note and the clear asks. Short answers first:

• Audit period covered: 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31 (Type II period).
• Bridge letters: yes — we provide a bridge letter from our auditor that confirms there have been no material changes to controls since the report end date. We can include a short statement about control changes if needed.

Preferred transfer options (pick one):
1) Secure S3 presigned link (48-hour TTL) — our standard approach for reports and artifacts.
2) Encrypted ZIP via Accellion (if your team prefers a transfer appliance).
3) Secure SharePoint link — enterprise customers only.

What we typically share up front: the PDF SOC 2 Type II report (redacted for vendor-sensitive details), the bridge letter (when requested), and a short audit-scope matrix that maps in-scope systems to responsibilities. If auditors need additional artifacts (log samples, config snapshots, change-control records) we can pull a scoped set and share under an NDA or secure transfer.

I've attached a short intake checklist and a suggested one-liner replies we recommend for internal reviewers if you want quick turnarounds. Below are compact reply templates you can paste into threads with your procurement/audit teams.

One-line external reply templates (pick & send):
- "Thanks — please find Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter via the secure link below; let me know if you need specific artifacts and we'll scope them."
- "We've requested the SOC 2 Type II report and will provide a bridge letter; please list any artifact samples needed (logs, config snapshots) and an auditor contact for direct intake."

If you confirm preferred transfer option and the auditor contact (Olivia, cc'd), I'll generate the presigned link and share the package. Happy to set a 20-minute sync if you prefer to cover scope.

Best,
